In May 2026, Counter Terrorism Policing in the United Kingdom was investigating a series of antisemitic attacks targeting the Jewish community in London. These attacks included arson directed at synagogues, community charities, and residential buildings. Notable incidents included the arson of a Hatzola ambulance and stabbings in Golders Green. The group Harakat Ashab al-Yamin al-Islamia (HAYI), linked to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), was identified as responsible for many of these attacks. The investigation led to over 80 arrests and heightened security measures for the Jewish community in the area.
